traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.desc: If the abveku dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The abveku has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abveku makes four Scything Claw attacks and uses Mesmerizing Dance if available.

actions.name: Scything Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Dance (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature within a 20-foot Emanation originating from the abveku. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the abveku takes the Hide action.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: The abveku is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: The abveku adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the sarrukh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The sarrukh has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sarrukh makes three attacks, using Trident or Necrotic Spit in any combination.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (6d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 90 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Poison damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Venomous Teleport (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The sarrukh teleports up to 120 feet to an occupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space the sarrukh leaves or arrives in (sarrukh's choice) is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 22 (4d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Shape Control
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the sarrukh can see shape-shifts. Response: The sarrukh chooses the resulting form from among the options available to the shape-shifting creature or prevents the creature from shape-shifting.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.desc: If the rendelith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into gravel, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The rendelith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The rendelith deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rendelith makes two Stone Hammer attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|Shatter]] (level 6 version).

actions.name: Stone Hammer
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage. Hit or Miss: The hammer magically returns to the rendelith's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The rendelith casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Move Earth|Move Earth]], [[Tools/Spells/Passwall|Passwall]], [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|Shatter]] (level 6 version), [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|Wall of Stone]]

bonus_actions.name: Quick Fortifications (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The rendelith uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Move Earth|Move Earth]] or [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|Wall of Stone]].

sb.name: Sarrukh Tyrant

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the sarrukh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The sarrukh has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sarrukh makes two attacks, using Bite or Fearsome Fauchard in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Poison damage.

actions.name: Fearsome Fauchard
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it has the Frightened condition. If the target already has the Frightened condition, it takes an additional 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Hit or Miss: The fauchard magically returns to the sarrukh's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sarrukh casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]] (level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]

reactions.name: Shape Control
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the sarrukh can see shape-shifts. Response: The sarrukh chooses the resulting form from among the options available to the shape-shifting creature or prevents the creature from shape-shifting.

legendary_actions.name: Fearsome Glance
legendary_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature the sarrukh can see within 30 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Slither
legendary_actions.desc: The sarrukh moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Twisted Transformation
legendary_actions.desc: The sarrukh uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]], and if the target fails its saving throw, the target also has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. The sarrukh can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Szass Tam

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.desc: If Szass Tam fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spirit Jar
traits.desc: If destroyed, Szass Tam re-forms in 1d10 days if he has a spirit jar, reviving with all his Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within Szass Tam's lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Szass Tam makes three attacks, using Paralyzing Touch or Soul-Draining Ray in any combination. He can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|Finger of Death]].

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Szass Tam's next turn.

actions.name: Soul-Draining Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +13, range 120 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Szass Tam casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|Finger of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]] (level 8 version), [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]] (level 8 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|Animate Dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Power Word Kill|Power Word Kill]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.desc: Szass Tam casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Deathly Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Szass Tam teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space he left takes 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from Szass Tam. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and the creature's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Szass Tam can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Withering Magic
legendary_actions.desc: Szass Tam casts [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]] or [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Evocation Sculptor
traits.desc: When Thrul casts a spell that creates an area of effect, she can choose herself and up to five other creatures she can see, sculpting the spell's energy around them. A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Thrul has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Thrul makes four Arcane Burst attacks. She can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]] (level 5 version) or [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]] (level 5 version).

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Thrul casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|Alter Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]] (level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Illusory Script|Illusory Script]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]] (level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Demiplane|Demiplane]], [[Tools/Spells/Modify Memory|Modify Memory]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]], [[Tools/Spells/Sunburst|Sunburst]]

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Thrul casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
